grammar.title: Present perfect continuous untuk pengalaman yang masih berjalan
grammar.explanation: Untuk kegiatan yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung sampai sekarang, pakai have/has been + V-ing dengan 'for' (lamanya) atau 'since' (titik mulai). Kalimat ini sangat sering dipakai saat wawancara.
examples: I've been working as a developer for three years.
She's been studying for IELTS since January.
How long have you been living here?

grammar.title: Kata kerja -ing setelah preposisi
grammar.explanation: Setelah preposisi (in, for, about, at, to pada 'look forward to'), kata kerja memakai bentuk -ing. Ini sering muncul di email lamaran dan wawancara.
examples: I'm interested in joining your team.
Thank you for considering my application.
I'm good at explaining technical ideas.

common_mistake.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
common_mistake.right: I look forward to hearing from you.

reading.title: Why sleep helps you learn
reading.text: If you are studying for an exam, the best thing you can do tonight might be to go to bed early. Scientists have found strong evidence that sleep helps the brain store new information. During deep sleep, the brain replays what we learned during the day and moves it into long-term memory. In one study, students who slept after learning new words remembered more of them the next morning than students who stayed awake. On the other hand, pulling an all-nighter before a test can make it harder to recall facts, even if you spent more hours studying. In the long run, regular sleep may be one of the simplest ways to make progress with a new language.

questions.q: According to the text, what happens during deep sleep?
options: The brain moves new information into long-term memory

questions.q: In the study, which students remembered more words?
What is the writer's main advice?
options: Study all night before a test
Only learn new words in the morning

writing.prompt: Gaya IELTS Writing Task 2 (versi pendek). Tulis paragraf opini untuk pernyataan ini: 'Some people think working from home makes employees more productive. Do you agree or disagree?' Beri pendapatmu, dua alasan, satu contoh, dan sisi lainnya.
checklist: Pendapat jelas di kalimat pertama (In my opinion / I believe)
Memakai 'On the other hand' untuk sisi lain
writing.model_answer: In my opinion, working from home makes many employees more productive, but not all of them. Firstly, people save time because they do not have to commute. For example, I used to spend almost two hours a day in traffic, and now I use that time to finish tasks or study English. Secondly, it is easier to focus at home, where there are fewer meetings and interruptions. On the other hand, some people find it hard to separate work from personal life, and they may feel lonely without their colleagues. Teams also need clear written communication, otherwise small problems take longer to solve. Overall, I believe working from home increases productivity for people who can manage their own time, as long as the company supports them with good tools and regular check-ins.

speaking.prompt: Gaya IELTS Speaking Part 2: ceritakan satu keterampilan yang ingin kamu kuasai. Sebutkan apa itu, kenapa penting, dan bagaimana kamu mempelajarinya (4 sampai 6 kalimat).
speaking.sample_answer: One skill I'd really like to master is public speaking. In my job I often have to explain technical ideas to people who aren't developers, and I sometimes get nervous. I think it's important because good ideas are useless if you can't explain them clearly. At the moment I'm practising by recording short presentations and watching them back. I've also been joining online meetups where I can speak English. In the long run, I hope to give a talk at a tech conference.

n1.them: Good morning. Could you start by telling us why you're applying for this scholarship?
hints: sebut tujuan studi: I'm applying because I want to ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "I'm applying because I want to study human-computer interaction and build better digital products."

n2.them: Interesting. What experience do you have in this field?

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "I've been working as a web developer for three years, and I'm responsible for our mobile app."

n3.them: What would you say is your biggest weakness?
hints: sebut kelemahan dan cara memperbaikinya: One weakness I'm working on is ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "One weakness I'm working on is public speaking, so I've been practising with short presentations."

n4.them: And what do you plan to do after you graduate?
hints: In the long run, I'd like to ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "In the long run, I'd like to go back to Indonesia and lead a product team."

n5.them: Thank you. Do you have any questions for us?
hints: tanya: Could you tell me more about ...?

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Yes, could you tell me when we'll hear about the results? Thank you for your time."

end.them: Thank you, Bagus. We'll let you know the result within two weeks. Good luck!
